verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms JumpCloud offers SSO enforcement across SAML/OIDC apps, but there is no mention of a pre-built app catalog size, number of integrations, or 'minutes to connect' claims — the specific claim of a large pre-built catalog is unevidenced. Community comments praise cross-OS MDM/SSO generally but don't address app catalog breadth or setup speed. Missing for 10: catalog size/number of pre-built integrations, evidence of quick no-code setup for specific popular apps, and independent corroboration of catalog breadth.
